data.body:
Every other AWS CLI failure branch in this step (`list-layer-versions`, `get-layer-version`, `add-layer-version-permission`, `get-layer-version-policy`) redirects stderr into the captured variable (`2>&1`) and echoes it to the log before emitting the `::warning::`/`::error::` annotation, so the operator can see *why* the call failed. The `publish-layer-version` call is missing this: it has no `2>&1`, so on failure `$PUBLISH_RESULT` is empty and only a generic "Failed to publish the layer in ${REGION}" is surfaced, hiding the actual AWS error (throttling, invalid `--compatible-runtimes java25`, quota, etc.) from the structured annotation and making failures harder to diagnose from the workflow summary.

Fix: capture and echo stderr the same way the sibling blocks do.
